transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We're in the research phase for our connectivity infrastructure. I've been evaluating five providers over the past month. Need to make a decision by quarter-end.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I appreciate your thorough approach. Since you're comparing multiple providers, what specific criteria are most important for your final decision?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Reliability is number one, then scalability as we grow, and cost predictability. I need to present a comprehensive comparison to my CTO next week.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. I'll prepare a detailed comparison matrix showing how we perform against those three criteria versus your other options, plus include case studies from similar startups. Would a technical deep-dive with your CTO be helpful?
